svg.title: Workflow: Execute MCP Tool
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram. An external AI client calls a typed tool; the edge hides the origin, the public server bounds the request and the gateway is the single policy point before any domain service is touched. Messages: 1. POST /mcp; 2. rewrite to Cloud Run; 3. validate envelope + bounds; 4. JSON-RPC error (429); 5. invoke(tool, args); 6. registry + RBAC + risk level; 7. confirmation required; 8. Idempotency-Key check; 9. typed, bounded read; 10. rows; 11. sanitize result; 12. typed result; 13. tool result.
svg.text: An external AI client calls a typed tool; the edge hides the origin, the public server bounds the request and the gateway is the
single policy point before any domain service is touched.
OAuth admin role + explicit user approval
The gateway is the single policy enforcement point: every client — Claude,
Codex or the in-site agent — gets the same RBAC, risk policy, idempotency
Result: Typed, sanitized tool result; writes need an admin role and explicit confirmation
